_readme: Accepted-measurement policies for AnonRouter's own confidential gateway (the
first of the two hops this SDK verifies). The second hop, the upstream model
provider's enclave, is pinned separately in measurements.json.
THIS FILE MUST NEVER BE FETCHED FROM THE GATEWAY IT DESCRIBES. A verifier that
downloads its allowlist from the server it is verifying can always be handed an
allowlist naming that server. It ships inside the published packages instead, and
the CI parity gate proves the JavaScript and Python copies never drift.
status=published  a released plane, resolved by verifyGateway() by default.
status=candidate  a reviewed but pre-release plane whose pins are expected to
move. Requires allowCandidate: true, so a default call can
never quietly pass against a plane that is not released.
Every switch in a policy is REQUIRED. A truncated or hand-edited policy fails to
parse rather than silently disabling a check.

policies.notes: AnonRouter confidential content plane running in an Intel TDX CVM (Large class). Published from the independently retained production release manifest with SHA-256 83205494da15f59b4b9a86ce3be77d331ef06d212ab9ed1a9cacfea1cdcbb730, which corresponds to the operator-side policy generation 2026-09-04-tinfoil-verifier. That manifest binds reviewed source commit 696b8dde01ed3087611ba43c7572d50098360b98, the exact measured app compose c6f11cc59aeafc71eb02245fa90fcceac00afbc4706071e39c582c26b8427a0e, the digest-pinned content-plane image sha256:76981a773b6fe1bebd56a32a6f1e7f9eeee20b15ea073c2e9f64acf9994d4070 and eleven further digest-pinned images, the app id, the instance id, the canonical production origin, the TLS SPKI and the platform measurements. Every value here was re-observed on 2026-09-04 in two independent nonce-bound quotes, one per origin, and the leaf SPKI each quote names was separately observed on the wire for that hostname. api.private.anonrouter.ai is retained as an attested alias; api.anonrouter.ai is the customer default. The release id is not treated as sufficient identity: app id, compose hash and every platform measurement remain independently pinned, and mrConfigId independently re-states the compose hash in a register the guest cannot re-narrate. RTMR0 is the hardware-configuration register and moves with CVM size; it was not reproduced offline with dstack-mr, so it rests on agreeing independent quotes and the retained manifest rather than on an offline recomputation. Two third-party source-to-digest provenance gaps named in the manifest (caddy-edge-base, node-base-image) remain supply-chain limitations, not attestation bypasses. requireHardwareVerified remains true, so verification fails closed unless a DCAP chain verifier is supplied.
